C0864.title: ICBC Financial Services Hit by Ransomware Attack
keywords: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China subsidiary
C0864.summary: On November 8, 2023, ICBC Financial Services (ICBCFS), a wholly-owned U.S. subsidiary of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, suffered a ransomware attack that disrupted some systems. Following the attack, ICBCFS immediately isolated affected systems and reported to law enforcement.
